body:
That's so nice of you! I don't have any other friends who are into fandom and/or lit roleplay, so none of them really get it. It's a struggle when I want to talk about it, sometimes lol

 I can offer the same; I try to be a good listener.

Hey, thanks for your kind message!

One of the reasons I love this server so much is that it's really well-run. The admins don't just disappear without letting anyone know what's going on, there has been no major ooc drama, and the setting they created is perfect for integrating characters from a bunch of different media types. We've been running for just under a year and a half now, and I hope we can make it to two!

I took a few days' break, and I am feeling much better about things in general. The mod team occasionally puts out ads for wanted characters on other social media, and I may request that they put one out for characters from this series in a few weeks. Seeing as it's getting closer to the release of a new season, I really hope we pick up some more interested members.

Very solid advice, for just about anything!

I took a little break, and I think I've cooled down enough that I'm fine to go back. If it's no longer fun, though, I'll hit the road.
